verdict.rationale: The evidence shows iTerm2's source lives in a public GitHub repository (github.com/gnachman/iTerm2). A community report also describes reading an upstream iTerm2 commit, which confirms the source is publicly readable. No item states what license governs that code, so the 'open license' half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation of the license (e.g. GPL or another OSI license), a license file or terms statement, and independent corroboration of the open-source licensing.
